channel.title: Noty
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
Lean the whole deck one way, and close a note back to the tabs

- Every tab, chip and note now leans at the same angle instead of a per-note
random one. Matching angles read as deliberate; scattered ones just looked
like a bug.
- Closing a note (Esc, Close, archive, delete) steps back to the deck rather
than dismissing it — the tabs stay where they were, and only leaving the edge
puts the deck to sleep. A click in another app still dismisses the lot.
- Screenshots, the demo recording and the site rebuilt against the final look.
